The Ann–Ben block must be consecutive, with Cara before Elif before Ann before Hana, and Gus at least three slots after Ann. The only placement that also keeps Dev at least three slots from Ann, Ben, Cara, and Gus, with Dev before Gus, is Ann in 6 and Ben in 7. That forces Gus into 9 and Hana into 8.

The remaining distance constraints then fill slots 1–5: Dev in 1, Finn in 2, Ivo in 3, Cara in 4, Elif in 5. Every constraint holds.
